Remark
[right-invariant fields are the Killing fields of a left-invariant metric]

Source: petersen:page-0156 ↗ prop:pet-ch4-left-translation-isometry ↗ def:pet-ch4-lie-algebra-exp For $X\in \mathfrak g$, the flow $F^t(x)=x\exp (tX)=R_{\exp (tX)}(x)$ need not act by isometries of a merely left-invariant metric, unless the metric is also invariant under right translations (biinvariant); thus elements of $\mathfrak g$ are not in general Killing fields. Instead, it is the right-invariant fields -- with flow $F^t(x)=\exp (tX)x=L_{\exp (tX)}(x)$ -- that are Killing fields for a left-invariant metric, by subsection 4.1.
